mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document( knowledge_base_id, document_key, title, file_name, file_type, mime_type, file_size, storage_url, source_type, status, checksum, created_by ) VALUES( #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentKey}, #{title}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{storageUrl}, #{sourceType}, #{status}, #{checksum}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND status != 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_document WHERE status != 'DELETED'
SELECT * FROM knowledge_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT knowledge_base_id AS knowledgeBaseId, COUNT(*) AS documentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'READY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS readyDocumentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('UPLOADED', 'PARSING', 'CHUNKING', 'INDEXING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processingDocumentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedDocumentCount, MAX(updated_at) AS latestDocumentUpdatedAt FROM knowledge_document WHERE status != 'DELETED' GROUP BY knowledge_base_id
